## IA drift review — `05-stress-ia-drift`

Twelve findings, but they collapse into **three real issues** plus some hygiene noise. The cluster pattern matters more than the per-finding scores: orphans + parallel destinations + concept aliases are almost certainly the same unfinished refactor.

### Blocking-quality (fix before merge)

**1. Permission IA Drift on `/admin`** — `crime_00001`
Three different role tokens (`admin`, `manager`, `owner`) gate the same destination across nav + route guard + docs. This is access-control correctness, not style. The route guard alone mixes `admin`/`manager`/`owner` literals (`src/routes/admin.ts:2,4,9`) — whichever one is wrong is a real bug. Centralise the check, pick the canonical token.

**2. Parallel `/billing-plans` destinations** — `crime_00006` + `crime_00007` + `crime_00008`
`/admin/billing-plans` and `/billing-plans` both exist, share tokens, and **both are orphaned** (no nav, no doc, no import). A user / agent updating one will silently skip the other. Decide which is canonical, redirect or delete the other. Treat 6/7/8 as one ticket.

### Follow-ups (track, don't block)

**3. Tenant concept alias drift** — `crime_00004` + orphans `crime_00009`, `crime_00010`
`organisation`, `team`, `workspace` all coexist as tenant-ish concepts, and two of the three route files (`/organisation`, `/workspace`) are orphaned. Same smell as the billing-plans issue — looks like a half-finished rename. Worth a dedicated cleanup pass, but not blocking unless you're shipping a tenant-facing change in this PR.

**4. Missing agent context** — `crime_00002`
No `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / skill files. Real product gap for an agent-targeted repo, but it's net-new work, not a merge blocker.

**5. Docs drift** — `crime_00003` + `crime_00005`
Broken `/admin` doc link and three references to retired CLI subcommands (`iaq teams`, `iaq workspace`, `iaq refresh`). Low-risk, fix opportunistically — or codify in CI if it keeps recurring.

**6. Action label drift** — `crime_00011` + `crime_00012`
`archive` / `delete` / `remove` used interchangeably across `SeatList`, `TeamList`, `UserList`. Note these two findings are the same evidence under two detectors — count it as one issue. Copy-system work, not blocking.

### Summary

| Block merge | Follow-up |
|---|---|
| Permission drift on `/admin` (1) | Tenant concept + orphans (4, 9, 10) |
| Parallel `/billing-plans` + its orphans (6, 7, 8) | Missing agent context (2) |
| | Docs drift (3, 5) |
| | Action label drift (11, 12 — dedupe) |

The 0-`high` summary undersells the risk: the permission finding deserves to be treated as high-severity in practice because role-token inconsistency is correctness, not hygiene.
